auth.title: Log in to Culiplan
auth.description:
Log in and approve access. You are then sent back to Home Assistant and setup finishes on its own.

Tip: if the browser does not return to Home Assistant after you approve, set an external URL (Settings → System → Network) or enable My Home Assistant, then try again.

mealie_offer.title: Import from Mealie
mealie_offer.description: You have Mealie set up in Home Assistant. Culiplan can import your Mealie recipes in one go. This is optional: you can skip it and import later.

data.migrate_mealie: Import my Mealie recipe library now

mealie_credentials.title: Mealie Connection
mealie_credentials.description: Enter your Mealie server URL and an API token. The token is used only during import and is **never stored**.

data_description.mealie_token: Generate a token in Mealie → Profile → API Tokens. It will not be saved after import.

mealie_preview.title: Import Preview
mealie_preview.description:
Culiplan found the following in your Mealie library:

- **{will_import}** recipes ready to import
- **{will_flag}** recipes that need review
- **{will_skip}** recipes that will be skipped (duplicates)

Sample titles: {samples}

Confirm to start the import. You can undo this within 24 hours from the integration settings.

mealie_done.title: Import Complete
mealie_done.description:
Your Mealie recipe library has been imported into Culiplan.

- **Job ID**: {job_id}
- **Errors**: {errors} recipes could not be imported

You can roll back this import within 24 hours from Settings → Devices & Services → Culiplan → Configure.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Culiplan
reauth_confirm.description: Your Culiplan session has expired. Click **Submit** to re-authenticate.

error.invalid_mealie_url: Please enter your Mealie server URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:9000).
error.mealie_unreachable: Could not connect to your Mealie server. Check the URL and that Mealie is running.
error.mealie_timeout: The connection to Mealie timed out. Check that Mealie is reachable from Home Assistant.
error.mealie_token_required: Please enter a Mealie API token.

abort.missing_configuration: Integration not configured. Please configure it in the UI.
abort.wrong_account: The Culiplan account you authenticated with does not match the account that needed re-configuration. Re-run the action from the same account, or remove the entry and add the new account fresh.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Culiplan integration has been re-configured. Existing entities are preserved.

init.title: Culiplan Settings
init.description:
Configure pantry alerts, AI behaviour, and integration diagnostics.

Current AI mode: **{current_ai_mode}**.

data.rollback: Roll back Mealie import (available within 24 hours of import)

data_description.expiry_days: How far ahead the daily expiring-pantry sensor counts (1–30 days, default 3).
data_description.expiry_hours: When the binary expiring-soon alert fires (1–168 hours, default 48).
data_description.debug_ai: Write AI prompt/response logs to your HA config dir for 24 h. Off by default.
data_description.auto_update: When on (default), Culiplan installs new releases itself and restarts Home Assistant to apply them. Turn off on Core/venv installs where you'd rather restart Home Assistant manually.
data_description.advanced_ai: Cloud AI is the default. Turn this on to switch to your own API key or a local model.
data_description.check_for_update: Checks GitHub for a newer release and lets you update with one click. No HACS or terminal needed.

advanced_ai.title: AI Mode
advanced_ai.description:
Choose how Culiplan AI features run.

**Cloud** (default): Culiplan runs AI requests for you. Free, nothing to set up.
**Bring your own key**: your API key stays in Home Assistant and calls go straight to the AI provider. Culiplan never sees the key.
**Local**: requests go to your own Ollama or LM Studio server.

advanced_ai_byok.title: Bring Your Own Key
advanced_ai_byok.description: Enter the provider and API key Culiplan should use. The key is stored in Home Assistant only. Culiplan never sees it.

data_description.byok_api_key: Stored in Home Assistant only. Never sent to Culiplan.

advanced_ai_local.title: Local AI
advanced_ai_local.description: Point Culiplan at your local Ollama or LM Studio instance.

advanced_ai_local_remote_warning.title: Remote AI Endpoint
advanced_ai_local_remote_warning.description:
The endpoint **{endpoint}** is on a remote host. Your AI prompts (which may include recipe names, meal plans, and pantry contents) will be sent to this address over your network.

If this is intentional (e.g. a server on your home network), tick the box and continue. If you are unsure, go back and use `localhost` instead.

data.confirmed: I understand and want to continue

update.title: Update Culiplan
update.description:
Update available: **{current}** → **{latest}**. Home Assistant will restart automatically to apply the new version.

{notes}

data_description.confirm: Downloads the release from GitHub, backs up the current integration directory, swaps the files, and restarts Home Assistant. A backup is kept until the swap succeeds; on failure the old version is restored automatically.

error.byok_key_invalid: The API key is invalid or was rejected by the provider. Please check your key and try again. Detail: {error_detail}
error.byok_validation_error: An unexpected error occurred while validating the key. Please try again. Detail: {error_detail}
error.local_endpoint_unreachable: Could not reach the local AI endpoint. Check the URL and that the service is running.
error.local_endpoint_invalid: The endpoint URL is not valid. Use the format http://host:port (e.g. http://localhost:11434).
error.update_check_failed: Could not reach GitHub to check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.update_failed: The update failed. The previous version has been restored automatically. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.rollback_complete: The Mealie import has been rolled back. Your Culiplan recipe library has been restored to its previous state.
abort.rollback_failed: The rollback request failed. Please try again or contact Culiplan support.
abort.up_to_date: You're already on the latest version of Culiplan.

suggest_meal.name: Suggest a meal
suggest_meal.description: Asks Culiplan AI to suggest a meal. Fires culiplan_suggest_meal_result event and creates a persistent notification.

constraints.name: Constraints
constraints.description: Free-text dietary or preference constraints, e.g. "vegetarian, under 30 minutes".

meal_slot.name: Meal slot
meal_slot.description: Which meal of the day to suggest for (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack).

max_time_minutes.name: Max cooking time (minutes)
max_time_minutes.description: Maximum total cooking time in minutes.

fill_shopping_list.name: Fill shopping list
fill_shopping_list.description: Asks Culiplan AI to populate the active shopping list for the planned meals of the given week. Fires culiplan_fill_shopping_list_result event.

week_offset.name: Week offset
week_offset.description: Which week to fill for (0 = this week, 1 = next week, -1 = last week).

pantry_add.name: Add pantry item
pantry_add.description: Adds an item to your Culiplan pantry stock (same as saying "add milk to the fridge"). Existing items are matched by name; a new stock line is created with the given quantity, unit, location and expiry.

name.name: Item name
name.description: What to add, e.g. "milk" or "basmati rice".

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How much to add. Defaults to 1.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of measurement, e.g. piece, g, kg, ml, l, pack. Defaults to piece.

location.name: Storage location
location.description: Where the item is stored: pantry, fridge, freezer, counter, spice_rack or other. Defaults to pantry.

expiration_days.name: Expires in (days)
expiration_days.description: Days from today until the item expires. Leave empty if unknown.

start_cooking_mode.name: Start cooking mode
start_cooking_mode.description: Starts a guided cooking session for the given recipe.

advance_cooking_step.name: Advance to next cooking step
advance_cooking_step.description: Moves the active cooking session forward by one step.

set_recipe_timer.name: Set a recipe timer
set_recipe_timer.description: Adds a named timer to the active cooking session and starts the HA timer entity.

cancel_recipe_timer.name: Cancel a recipe timer
cancel_recipe_timer.description: Removes a named timer from the active cooking session.

resume_cooking_mode.name: Resume cooking mode
resume_cooking_mode.description: Resumes the most recently paused cooking session.

complete_cooking_mode.name: Complete cooking mode
complete_cooking_mode.description: Marks the active cooking session as completed.

generate_blueprint.name: Generate automation blueprint
generate_blueprint.description: Generates a Home Assistant automation blueprint YAML from a natural language description using Culiplan AI. Works in Cloud, BYOK and Local AI mode.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.description: Natural language description of the automation you want to create.

available_entities.name: Available entities
available_entities.description: List of entity IDs available in your Home Assistant install (max 100).

install.name: Install blueprint
install.description: Write the generated YAML to config/blueprints/automation/culiplan/ and reload HA blueprints.

reauth_required.title: Re-authentication required for Culiplan
reauth_required.description: Your Culiplan session has expired. [Re-authenticate your account]({url}).

pantry_barcode_not_found.title: Culiplan: Barcode not found in pantry
pantry_barcode_not_found.description: The barcode {barcode} was scanned but no matching item was found in your Culiplan pantry. Open Culiplan and add an item with this barcode, then scanning it again will resolve this issue.

feature_unavailable.title: A Culiplan feature isn't available
feature_unavailable.description: **{feature}** isn't available for your Culiplan account. If you think this is a mistake, [contact Culiplan support]({support_url}).

plan_first_week.title: Plan your first week in Culiplan

confirm.title: Plan your first week in Culiplan
confirm.description:
Your Culiplan meal plan is empty, so the calendar and meal sensors have nothing to show yet.

[Open the Culiplan planner]({planner_url}) and add a few meals. The calendar fills automatically, no restart needed.

Select **Submit** to hide this message.

byok_key_missing.message: No BYOK key found for provider {provider}. Please reconfigure the Culiplan integration.

pantry_add_failed.message: Could not add {name} to the pantry: {error}

pantry_item_not_found.message: No pantry item with barcode {barcode} found. Add the item to your pantry in Culiplan first.

blueprint_envelope_missing.message: Backend returned no prompt envelope for blueprint generation.

no_active_cooking_session.message: No active cooking session. Call culiplan.start_cooking_mode first.

cooking_already_last_step.message: Already at the last step ({current}/{total}). Use culiplan.complete_cooking_mode to finish.

no_paused_cooking_session.message: No paused cooking session found. Nothing to resume.

timer_not_found.message: No timer with label or id {label_or_id} found in the active session.
